title.narrative: Kenya. Strategic Sector Cooperation on energy

description.narrative:
Preparation project
The project supports the goal of the Danish Strategy for Development cooperation of contributing to the global reduction of CO2 by assisting developing countries having large and predicted large emissions of CO2 - and countries in Africa. The strategy identifies the Government-to-government cooperation as an important instrument for partner countries to reach their climate goals and initiating a green transition of the economy. The project is part of a green enlargement of the total SSC cooperation in Africa approved in 2021.
The inception phase is the initial preparation of a possible long term Strategic Sector Cooperation between energy authorities in Denmark and in Kenya. The choice of Kenya as a new SSC partner country on energy was approved by the Danish Minister for Development Cooperation in June 2021 as part of a general enhancement of green SCC engagements in Africa. The main outcome of the project is a project document describing the full SSC cooperation, divided into phases of approximately three years of commitment. The project activities includes analysis, workshops, meetings, travels and a study tour of relevant key Kenyan officials to Denmark. The project will be supported by a sector adviser posted at the Danish embassy in Nairobi in January 2021.
